prompt: Locked-off static camera, the frame never moves. One continuous shot, no cuts. Cheap colour film, soft grain, warm pub lamps, teal rain on the windows. The lad in the hi-vis vest looks up at the standing bearded man in the beanie and speaks, mouth moving, brow puzzled. A beat later the bearded man turns his eyes down to him and answers in a few calm words, lips barely moving, shoulders still, backpack and rolled mat unmoving. The quizmaster holds the microphone and watches. The handwritten card on the table lies flat and untouched, its number unchanged. Everyone else stays seated and still. Thanks.
why: The lad asks how he knew; Bob, standing, answers quietly.
